description: Retrieves metric alert rules for a Sentry organization by ID or slug. A 404 with the detail “The requested resource does not exist” is returned as an empty list, which does not by itself establish that the organization has no rules.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization for which alert rules are to be fetched. Slugs are typically the organization's name in lowercase, using hyphens for spaces (e.g., 'acme-corp').
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

name: fetch_organization_alert_rules

aggregate.description: Aggregate function used in the alert rule (e.g., 'count', 'count_unique', 'avg', 'p50', 'p75', 'p95', 'p99', 'p100', 'percentile', 'apdex', 'failure_rate').
aggregate.title: Aggregate

comparisonDelta.description: Time delta for comparison period in minutes. Can be null.
comparisonDelta.title: Comparison Delta

createdBy.description: Information about the user who created the alert rule.
createdBy.title: Created By

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the alert rule was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

dateModified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the alert rule was last modified.
dateModified.title: Date Modified

environment.description: Name of environment to filter by. Can be null to include all environments.
environment.title: Environment

errors.description: List of validation or processing errors. Can be null.
errors.title: Errors

eventTypes.description: List of event types included in the rule (e.g., 'default', 'error', 'transaction').
eventTypes.title: Event Types

id.description: Unique identifier for the alert rule.
id.title: Id

includeAllProjects.description: Whether this alert rule applies to all projects in the organization.
includeAllProjects.title: Include All Projects

name.description: The name of the metric alert rule.
name.title: Name

organizationId.description: The organization ID that owns this alert rule.
organizationId.title: Organization Id

originalAlertRuleId.description: Reference to the original alert rule if this is a copy or derived rule. Can be null.
originalAlertRuleId.title: Original Alert Rule Id

owner.description: Owner identifier (team or user ID, e.g., 'team:74234'). Can be null.
owner.title: Owner

projects.description: List of project slugs associated with this alert rule.
projects.title: Projects

query.description: Event search query to monitor (e.g., 'http.status_code:400' or empty string for no filter).
query.title: Query

queryType.description: Query type indicator for the alert rule.
queryType.title: Query Type

resolution.description: Resolution value for the alert rule.
resolution.title: Resolution

resolveThreshold.description: Threshold value for alert resolution. Can be null.
resolveThreshold.title: Resolve Threshold

snooze.description: Whether the alert rule is currently snoozed (paused).
snooze.title: Snooze

status.description: The status of the alert rule (0 represents a specific state).
status.title: Status

thresholdPeriod.description: The number of time periods that must meet the threshold before triggering.
thresholdPeriod.title: Threshold Period

thresholdType.description: Type classification for threshold (0 for 'Higher than', 1 for 'Lower than').
thresholdType.title: Threshold Type

timeWindow.description: The time period to aggregate over, represented in minutes.
timeWindow.title: Time Window

triggers.description: Array of trigger objects that define when the alert fires.
triggers.title: Triggers

CreatedBy.description: Information about the user who created the alert rule.
CreatedBy.title: CreatedBy

FetchOrganizationAlertRulesResponse.description: Response schema detailing the organization's active metric alert rules. Returns a list of alert rules directly.
FetchOrganizationAlertRulesResponse.title: FetchOrganizationAlertRulesResponse

Trigger.description: Trigger object that defines when the alert fires.

actions.description: Array of actions to perform when the trigger fires.
actions.title: Actions

alertRuleId.description: Reference to the parent alert rule ID.
alertRuleId.title: Alert Rule Id

alertThreshold.description: The threshold value that triggers the alert.
alertThreshold.title: Alert Threshold

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the trigger was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

resolveThreshold.description: The value at which the alert resolves. Can be null.
resolveThreshold.title: Resolve Threshold

Trigger.title: Trigger

TriggerAction.description: Action to perform when a trigger fires.

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the action was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

inputChannelId.description: Channel ID for Slack notifications. Can be null.
inputChannelId.title: Input Channel Id

integrationId.description: Integration ID associated with the action. Can be null.
integrationId.title: Integration Id

sentryAppId.description: Sentry app ID when action involves a Sentry app. Can be null.
sentryAppId.title: Sentry App Id

targetIdentifier.description: ID of the target. Integer for PagerDuty and Sentry apps, string for others.
targetIdentifier.title: Target Identifier

TriggerAction.title: TriggerAction
